modules.name: Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL)
modules.description: Core testing fundamentals: testing throughout the SDLC, static testing, test techniques, test management, and tool support.
modules.syllabusRef: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level Syllabus v4.0

modules.name: Agile Tester Extension
modules.description: Agile fundamentals, the tester's role on agile teams, agile testing methods, tools, and techniques.
modules.syllabusRef: ISTQB Foundation Level Agile Tester Syllabus

modules.name: Advanced Level Test Analyst
modules.description: Advanced black-box test techniques, defect-based and experience-based testing, and the test analyst's role in reviews.
modules.syllabusRef: ISTQB Advanced Level Test Analyst Syllabus

modules.name: Advanced Level Technical Test Analyst
modules.description: White-box techniques, quality characteristics testing (performance, security, reliability), and technical review skills.
modules.syllabusRef: ISTQB Advanced Level Technical Test Analyst Syllabus

modules.name: Advanced Level Test Manager
modules.description: Test planning, estimation, risk management, test monitoring and control, and team management for test managers.
modules.syllabusRef: ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager Syllabus

modules.name: Certified Tester Test Automation Engineer
modules.description: Test automation architecture, frameworks, tool selection, and generic and specific test automation activities.
modules.syllabusRef: ISTQB Certified Tester Test Automation Engineer Syllabus

modules.name: Performance Testing
modules.description: Performance testing types, risks, planning, metrics, monitoring tools, and results analysis and reporting.
